LanguageData.MM_Guardian.label: Guardian
LanguageData.MM_Guardian.description:
A small construct for defense and shield support, using 2 bandwidth. It can attack with a continuous laser or restore shields on allied units and turrets, but cannot do both at once.

Automatic shield support is enabled by default. With automatic combat off, it only provides automatic support while drafted. It also hauls up to 40 kg, cleans and fights fires. It has a 75-point shield and consumes 20 light per game hour to recharge.

Spend 10 seeds to immediately create an 8-cell-radius shield for 30 seconds. Each hostile projectile touching it has a 50% chance to return along its original path; otherwise it passes through. Fields from different Guardians roll independently and can overlap.
LanguageData.MM_Guardian.tools.0.label: support claws
LanguageData.MM_GuardianProjector.label: Guardian beam emitter
LanguageData.MM_GuardianProjector.description: The Guardian's built-in emitter provides continuous fire or restores allied shields. It cannot attack and restore shields at the same time.
